other_conditions: Must be registered under the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers’ Welfare Board
Must have an active membership of the Board
Must wait three months from registration before becoming eligible for assistance
Benefit is available only once in a lifetime
Must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the preceding one year
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 for the purchase of toolkits for registered building and construction workers.
